news.title: Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited (NSEI:AVONMORE) completed the acquisition of Excelling Geo & Engineering Consultant Private Limited.
news.body:
Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited (NSEI:AVONMORE) agreed to acquire Excelling Geo & Engineering Consultant Private Limited for INR 10 million on February 13, 2026. Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited (NSEI:AVONMORE) entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire Excelling Geo & Engineering Consultant Private Limited on April 10, 2026. A cash consideration valued at INR 100 per share will be paid by Avonmore Capital & Management Services Limited. As part of consideration, INR 10 million will be paid towards common equity of Excelling Geo & Engineering Consultant Private Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Excelling Geo & Engineering Consultant Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 21.22 million.
